summary: verification seam v2 — default autonomous engineering verification with REAL gate execution

src/shared/result-validator.ts: VerifyInput.unavailable + VerifyVerdict.unavailable; unavailable can never satisfy plan alone (PASS requires >=1 real passed gate); plan-ordered reporting
electron/commander/main-commander.ts finalizeTask verificationGate recomputes with stored unavailable so a genuine PASS stays PASS

tests/unit/result-validator.test.ts (+3): unavailable-alone ⇒ REWORK; applicable-passed + unavailable ⇒ PASS; unavailable + missing ⇒ REWORK w/ gap

tests/unit/verification-contract.test.ts (seam v2): high-risk explicit contract on JS repo ⇒ real unit+integration evidence, typecheck/build UNAVAILABLE, verdict PASS + final; OWNER_RESULT work task auto-attaches contract and completes; failing acceptance-marked test in full sweep ⇒ REWORK park, no final; legacy control unchanged
notes: MODEL_DONE → VERIFYING → run real gates → PASS/REWORK is now the default for OWNER_RESULT engineering plans; a gate runner crash is isolated (task parked, Boss alive); missing applicable evidence can never PASS.
